name: Ruhi
description: Gardwen's befriended companion -- a loyal she-wolf; swift, keen-nosed and savage in the bite.
narrative: Ruhi is Gardwen's befriended companion, a she-wolf who pads at the druid's side through canal-town and wildwood alike. Fast (Move 8) and tireless, with a hunter's nose and ear (Track 84, Perception 74), she fights with a pack-savage bite and guards Gardwen with single-minded loyalty.

equipment.name: Pelt (natural armor, all locations)
equipment.notes: AP 1 each location; no armor penalty

extras.armor: Natural pelt, AP 1 on all 7 quadruped locations; no armor penalty
extras.sheet_notes: Roll20 sheet showed an unusually high INT 15 and some 'civilized' skills (Native Tongue 55, Customs 30, Locale 30) for an animal -- recorded as-is from the sheet (likely sheet defaults / a specially clever bonded companion); Spirit Combat 'Willpower 22%' left out as a sheet default.
extras.source: Roll20 Classic Fantasy character sheet (And then the Dragons Came campaign)

actor_notes:
Ruhi
LOOKS: Enormous, grey, winter coat coming out in handfuls.
CORE: A wolfhound who has organised her entire life around the position of one person, and who is a far better judge of a room than anybody standing in it.
NATURE: Absorbed, affectionate, immovable. Investigates everything nose-first and cannot be hurried. Leans her whole weight against a leg when she has decided a place is acceptable. Tracks the speaker's voice rather than the words, and comes up at a change in tone rather than at meaning.
WOUND: None. She is the only honest thing in most scenes.
WANTS: To be where Gardwen is, with the strangers further away.
PRESSURE: She stops. Not growling, not bristling -- stopped -- and around genuinely wrong things she will not settle and cannot be made to.
KEY: (the low chuff that means "I have told you something you already knew")
